jutsu.name: Shadow Dance
jutsu.description: A mesmerizing spectacle unfolds as the wielder's weapon becomes an integral part of their very essence. This intricate choreography of combat seamlessly melds martial finesse with the power of the Shadow Weaver bloodline.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user's weapon becomes an extension of their body as they engage in a mesmerizing dance of combat. With swift, rhythmic movements, %user strikes and slashes, each motion releasing bursts of shadow energy that cascade toward %target, inflicting a series of rapid and devastating blows. The seamless fusion of %user's mastery over shadows and their weapon creates a captivating and lethal performance on the battlefield.

jutsu.name: Opening Strike
jutsu.description: A hit that leaves the target exposed.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user strikes %target, leaving an opening for further attacks.

jutsu.name: Shadow Severance
jutsu.description: Shadow Severance enables the user to seize control of the target's shadow, summoning a scythe from the darkness. Through swift and precise movements, the user delivers strikes that sever both the physical form and the shadow of the target, leaving them without identity or substance.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user channels the power of the Shadow Weaver Bloodline, asserting dominance over %target's shadow. Emerging from the darkness, a scythe materializes, a manifestation of the shadow's chilling embrace. With unparalleled speed and precision, %user delivers devastating strikes, severing both the physical form and the shadow of %target, leaving them without an identity, a mere shell of their former self.

jutsu.description: Shadow Severance enables the user to seize control of the target's shadow, summoning a scythe from the darkness. Through swift and precise movements, the user delivers strikes that sever both the physical form and the shadow of the target, leaving them without identity or substance.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user channels the power of the Shadow Weaver Bloodline, asserting dominance over %target's shadow. Emerging from the darkness, a scythe materializes, a manifestation of the shadow's chilling embrace. With unparalleled speed and precision, %user delivers devastating strikes, severing both the physical form and the shadow of %target, leaving them without an identity, a mere shell of their former self.

jutsu.name: Enervating Strike
jutsu.description: Shared pool record S28. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user unleashes Enervating Strike on %target

jutsu.name: Fighter's Poise
jutsu.description: Shared pool record B37. Boss pool. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user takes the Fighter's Poise stance

jutsu.name: Cinder Bolt
jutsu.description: Shared pool record EF01. Balance values pending sign-off.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user unleashes Cinder Bolt on %target

item.name: Void-Rune Parchment
item.description: A scroll with 415 on it. Something about this reminds you of an Explosive Tag.
item.battleDescription: %user transfers chakra into the scroll before releasing it towards %target. So this is the power of the Black Maw.

item.name: Ember-sealed Scroll
item.description: A scroll with a 6 on it. Something about this reminds you of an Explosive Tag.

jutsu.name: Chakra Invigoration
jutsu.description: A quick movement technique that energizes the user and boosts their stats.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user surges forward in a burst of chakra-enhanced motion, leaving afterimages as they reposition across the battlefield. As their body moves, internal chakra flow heightens—enhancing physical and mental performance all at once.

jutsu.name: Chakra Overflow
jutsu.description: A potent chakra buff that enhances all offensive abilities and raises the user’s stats.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user channels a surge of chakra beyond their natural limit, their aura expanding in a volatile ripple of power. This overflowing chakra wraps around them in waves—thick, radiant, and barely restrained. Chakra Overflow heightens every offensive path: physical strikes land harder, ninjutsu hits with greater force, and even genjutsu becomes more potent. Simultaneously, the user’s core stats spike, fueling their body and mind for the intensity of high-stakes combat. It’s the edge between control and chaos—a moment where the user becomes a living conduit of power.

jutsu.name: Particle Cannon
jutsu.description: The ultimate power comes with the ultimate price.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user weaves an intricate triangle with their fingers, bringing forth a radiant orb that caresses %user's hand with a warm glow that both energizes and burns. Gradually, the sphere transforms, unfurling into a brilliant beam, propelled with purpose towards %target

jutsu.name: Rejuvenating Chakra
jutsu.description: A focused healing technique that restores the user’s health through controlled chakra flow.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user closes their eyes and channels chakra inward, guiding it through key points to accelerate recovery. Wounds close, fatigue fades, and their body regains strength as restorative chakra pulses through them.

jutsu.name: Atomic Shield
jutsu.description: Create a barrier of particles to protect you
jutsu.battleDescription: %user creates a translucent barrier made of the particles around them to defend from all attacks

jutsu.name: Prismatic Ward
jutsu.description: A defensive chakra field that hinders foes and bolsters power.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user channels their chakra into an intricate geometric prism, its multifaceted surfaces shimmering with vibrant energy. As the prism solidifies, its aura disrupts %target's focus, diminishing their ability to channel chakra effectively. Meanwhile, %user’s chakra resonates with the prism, amplifying their own potency for an impending assault.

jutsu.name: Dreamshell
jutsu.description: A deceptive genjutsu that damages the enemy while shielding the user from future harm.
jutsu.battleDescription: The user closes their eyes briefly as a translucent aura forms around them, distorting reality in rippling waves. A pulse of psychic force erupts outward, battering %target’s senses with unbearable pressure. At the same time, the user becomes cloaked in a dreamlike shell of chakra, dulling incoming attacks and reducing harm through pure illusory manipulation.

jutsu.name: Stonebreaker Strike
jutsu.description: A brutal earth-based taijutsu blow that smashes through defenses and shatters the ground.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user roots themselves to the ground, channeling dense earth chakra through their body and into their strike. With a sudden forward step, they deliver a crushing blow aimed at breaking not just the opponent, but the terrain itself. The sheer force of the attack sends a deep shockwave through the ground, cracking stone and rupturing the earth beneath their feet.

jutsu.name: Death's March
jutsu.description: Release waves of chakra that strikes your target
jutsu.battleDescription: %user envelops %target in a radiant chakra tunnel.  They unleash an unyielding wave of chakra, targeting their enemy's cells with relentless precision. As the assault subsides, the enemy's once-sturdy form crumbles, consumed by decay.

jutsu.name: Martial Movement
jutsu.description: A refined movement technique that evades attacks and reduces the enemy’s offensive power.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user shifts position with disciplined footwork and controlled breathing, weaving through combat with fluid precision. Their movements disrupt %target’s rhythm, dulling the force behind their attacks and reducing the damage they can deliver.

jutsu.name: Gale Force Kick
jutsu.description: A wind-infused taijutsu kick that strikes with explosive force, sending enemies flying.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user channels wind chakra into their legs, the air around them spiraling into a violent vortex. With a sudden burst of movement, they leap and twist, launching a devastating kick toward %target. The moment of impact unleashes a compressed burst of wind that strikes like a cannon blast—tearing through defenses and hurling the enemy backwards.

jutsu.name: Windshear Decay
jutsu.description: Razor sharp wind slashes that leave lasting and decaying effects
jutsu.battleDescription: %user forms a series of intricate hand seals which summons forth the power of the winds that once quelled Fujin's fury. With a swift motion, they unleash a torrent of razor-sharp wind slashes that tear through the air towards %target. The wind howls with a vengeful fury, and as the invisible blades connect, they slice deep into %target's flesh, leaving behind festering wounds. The air around %target grows heavy with the scent of decay as the slashes begin to fester and deepen over time, continuing to tear at their flesh with each passing moment.

jutsu.name: Eight Fist Style: Lotus Dance
jutsu.description: An elite taijutsu barrage that deals massive damage and briefly prevents the target from receiving buffs.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user’s stance drops low—tense, almost still—then detonates. With masterful precision and tempestuous speed, they unleash Eight Fist Style: Lotus Dance: eight rapid, deliberate strikes in perfect rhythm. Each blow strikes with surgical accuracy, shattering %target’s guard and driving them backward, balance crumbling under the relentless cadence.

jutsu.name: Decaying Touch
jutsu.description: Touch your target and start to destroy their body through a dusty decay.
jutsu.battleDescription: %user creates a dust cloud that surrounds %target. Dashing through the cloud, they appear in front of %target, placing their hand on them. %target slashes at %user, and their body becomes dust. Only after the dust has disappeared does %target realize that the part of their body that was touched is beginning to decay.

item.name: Chakra Disrupting Needles
item.description: You throw specially prepared needles that drain your target's vitality and cause their attacks to recoil against them.
item.battleDescription: Before %target can react, tiny needles strike them, draining their vitality and turning their attacks back against them.

item.name: Mirror of Retribution
item.description: A mystical shield reflects incoming attacks back to the attacker, leaving them vulnerable to their own power.
item.battleDescription: %user conjures a shimmering, translucent barrier that glows with an ethereal light. The air hums with power as the barrier takes shape, forming a perfect mirror-like surface.

item.name: Forsaken Blade
item.description: The Forsaken Kings prized possession, long discarded but one mighty swing will lead the path to victory.

item.name: Flak Jacket
item.description: The common Chunin Flack Jacket. Stylish, Resourceful, and Symbolic. You have the swagger now.

item.name: Wind Crystal
item.description: A gem imbued with natural Wind chakra. It increase Wind damage done.

item.name: Earth Crystal
item.description: A gem imbued with natural Earth chakra. It increase Earth damage done.

item.name: Chakra Sword
item.description: A sword with special markings on it that seem to make the sword react when used in conjunction with chakra elements.
item.battleDescription: Channeling chakra into their sword %user sends chakra slashes that cut into %target
